name: Baldur's Gate 2 Complete
description: Baldur's Gate 2 Complete is a singleplayer and multiplayer isometric role-playing game.

gog.store_details: This is the original 2000 Baldur's Gate II: Shadows of Amn with its Throne of Bhaal expansion. GOG stopped selling it by November 2016 (per GOG's forums), but it's still an ideal candidate for restoring EAX sound.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Baldur's Gate II ships with 'Environmental Audio' unset and only turns it on by itself the first time it starts with EAX available.

sources.title: GOG forum: BGEE, BG2EE, IWEE vs originals
